unit.id: The airline company Touri GmbH has prepared an analysis of revenue growth [%] in relation to customer growth [%]. Look at the scatter plot and determine whether a positive, negative, or no correlation exists. Draw the best-fit line in the diagram and calculate the company's revenue at a customer growth of 120%.#1

segment.source: The airline company Touri GmbH has prepared an analysis of revenue growth [%] in relation to customer growth [%]. Look at the scatter plot and determine whether a positive, negative, or no correlation exists. Draw the best-fit line in the diagram and calculate the company's revenue at a customer growth of 120%.
segment.target: Letalska družba Touri GmbH je pripravila analizo rasti prihodkov [%] v povezavi z rastjo števila strank [%]. Oglejte si razpršeni diagram in ugotovite, ali obstaja pozitivna, negativna ali nobena korelacija. V diagramu narišite najboljšo aproksimacijsko premico in izračunajte prihodke družbe pri 120-odstotni rasti števila strank.

unit.id: In the annual Wurzelweglauf in Konz, 30 people participated. The evaluation of the kilometers run is listed below. How many kilometers were covered on average (arithmetic mean)? What is the median of the kilometers covered? Select the data point as the median directly in the graph. State the difference between the two factors.#1

segment.source: In the annual Wurzelweglauf in Konz, 30 people participated. The evaluation of the kilometers run is listed below. How many kilometers were covered on average (arithmetic mean)? What is the median of the kilometers covered? Select the data point as the median directly in the graph. State the difference between the two factors.
segment.target: Na letnem teku »Wurzelweglauf« v Konzu je sodelovalo 30 oseb. Podatek o pretečenih kilometrih je naveden spodaj. Koliko kilometrov je bilo v povprečju pretečenih (aritmetična sredina)? Kakšna je mediana pretečenih kilometrov? Izberite podatkovno točko, ki predstavlja mediano, neposredno v grafu. Navedite razliko med tema dvema dejavnikoma.

unit.id: You work as a data analyst for SunscreenFans & Co GmbH, a company that sells sunscreen and fans across Europe. You have a full year of monthly data featuring three metrics: Income (€m), Revenue (€m), and Units Sold. Use the Charts Widget to complete the following tasks:#1

segment.source: You work as a data analyst for SunscreenFans & Co GmbH, a company that sells sunscreen and fans across Europe. You have a full year of monthly data featuring three metrics: Income (€m), Revenue (€m), and Units Sold. Use the Charts Widget to complete the following tasks:
segment.target: Delate kot analitik podatkov v podjetju SunscreenFans & Co GmbH, ki po vsej Evropi prodaja sončna mazila in ventilatorje. Na voljo imate podatke za celo leto, razčlenjene po mesecih, ki vključujejo tri kazalnike: prihodek (v milijonih evrov), promet (v milijonih evrov) in prodane enote. Uporabite widget »Charts«, da opravite naslednje naloge:
